finalText:
I've worked all the laptop dock and monitor backorders. 11 orders now have their stock reserved and are ready to ship, 3 have promise dates, and every one of those 14 customers has had a single notice.

**Two things changed while I worked:**
- **Two more deliveries came in.** PO-91 (4 docks) and PO-93 (3 monitors) were also received today, so there were 11 docks and 7 monitors to give out, not 7 and 4. I gave out all of it under the same rules. That also meant the earlier PO-91 and PO-93 arrival dates could no longer be used as promise dates.
- **The store's date is 2026-07-25, not the 2026-10-05 in my instructions.** I used the store's date. The newer policy update (PU-12, "aged backorders go first") is in force, so orders placed on or before 07-11 went first, oldest first, whatever the customer's tier. The other update (PU-9, gold ranked with platinum) only covered June, so I didn't apply it.

**Priority order:** first the aged orders O-5201, O-5202, O-5203 and O-5204. Then platinum (O-5206, O-5207), gold (O-5208, O-5209, O-5210) and standard (O-5211 to O-5215), oldest first within each tier.

**Stock reserved (now ready to ship):** O-5201, O-5202 (dock and monitor), O-5203, O-5204, O-5207, O-5208, O-5209, O-5210, O-5211, O-5212, O-5215. O-5207 is set to ship complete, so I reserved its dock and monitor together. Both products are now at zero on the shelf.

**Still waiting, with promise dates:**

| Order | Waiting for | Promised | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| O-5206 | Dock and USB-C hub | 2026-08-14 | Set to ship complete, and there are no hubs in stock. The hub would come on 08-06 and the dock with PO-95 on 08-14, so both lines get the later date. |
| O-5213 | 2 docks | 2026-08-14 | From PO-95 |
| O-5214 | 1 monitor | 2026-08-19 | From PO-97 |

**Not touched:** O-5205 is on risk hold, so I gave it no stock, no promise date and no message.

**Reviewer denials:**
- I tried twice to reserve monitors for O-5203 before PO-93 arrived, and the reviewer refused both times. Its reasons ranked the customer by tier and didn't apply PU-12. I didn't go along with that: I left the monitors unreserved rather than give them to O-5208 out of turn. Once PO-93 arrived, the reviewer applied PU-12 itself and O-5203 was reserved first, as the policy requires.
- My promise date for O-5212 was refused because PO-93 had already arrived. O-5212 got the last monitor in stock instead.
